notes: Section-level provenance for an empty extraction, not a compound record. Lines 881 to 951 of the rebuilt document were read in full, German and the EN convenience lines both, and the section genuinely names no chemical substance. It is EPO apparatus rather than applicant disclosure: the examiner's search report on application EP 07 01 6606, listing four cited documents (WO 00/21924 A, WO 03/047340 A, WO 2007/006415 A, EP 1 314 724 A), the IPC classification and searched fields, the category legend, and the place, date and examiner. Publication numbers are document identifiers and not compounds. The IPC symbols C07C317/24 and A01N41/10 are classification codes, not formulae, even though C07C317 reads as a chemical class. AVENTIS CROPSCIENCE GMBH, BAYER CROPSCIENCE GMBH and BAYER CROPSCIENCE AG are applicant company names. Muenchen is a place, Kiernan, Andrea is the examiner. Prosecution context for a later reader, an observation about the file rather than about the chemistry: two of the four citations are X category, WO 03/047340 A and WO 2007/006415 A, both Bayer CropScience, and both are cited against claims 1 to 16, that is the whole claim set. The report's own legend at line 928 defines X as 'von besonderer Bedeutung allein betrachtet', particularly relevant taken alone. The application's legal status is Withdrawn. Line numbers were remapped from the pre-rebuild document via /tmp/ep2045/linemap.json; no record content changed.
